notes: The in-memory scan per point query is about 0.48 ms including statement dispatch in the release build; the lattice removes about 0.17 ms (1.54x at volume).
The lattice loses on wide queries (S1 point returns 46,225 rows at 33 ms against 1 ms for the scan) because the table function materializes rows through the function path.
The profile gate's 1.37 ms per query via the python driver overestimated the scan share; the driver overhead was a large component.
The matrix point timings are below the CLI timer resolution of 1 ms; the volume measurement is the reliable comparison.
The I/O-dominated case (cold cache, larger table) is untested; the in-memory result is a measured near-parity.
